title: The Stone Watchers - A History of Rapa Nui and the Moai
author: Ethan James Farrell
description: A historical exploration of Rapa Nui and its monumental moai. The work introduces the island's cultural setting and the questions surrounding its stone figures, offering context for understanding them within the life of their makers.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. One format was converted from the other (PDF from EPUB).
